findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “Let us look first at Law and Grace”
findings.source_quote: Someone that is under the law does not desire to do what he must do, but rather, he does it because of the law.
findings.suggested_fix: Change “tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya” to “tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya, tetapi melakukannya karena hukum” only if needed for clarity; the current translation preserves the source meaning.
findings.translation_quote: Orang yang berada di bawah hukum tidak ingin melakukan apa yang harus dilakukannya, melainkan melakukannya karena hukum.

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “Let us look at grace”
findings.source_quote: You are not your own and you desire to be all you can be for your Savior who died for you.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri” with “Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri” only if retaining the idiom; otherwise, use “Kamu bukan milik dirimu sendiri,” preserving the meaning that the person belongs to another.
findings.translation_quote: Kamu bukan milikmu sendiri dan ingin melakukan segala yang kamu mampu bagi Juruselamatmu yang telah mati untukmu.

findings.location: source.html, paragraph beginning “A poor criminal who has only known the city streets as home”
findings.source_quote: God saves him, transforms him, converts him.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “membarui dirinya” with “mempertobatkannya” to preserve the distinct assertion that God converts him.
findings.translation_quote: Allah menyelamatkannya, mengubahnya, dan membarui dirinya.
